assertions: Ready floor and parked cap enforced; in-flight parking counts against retained limit. Surplus reservation remains until confirmed deletion. Deletion retry does not refill absent demand; renewed demand waits until old resource is physically gone. Existing recovery/parking/permit oracles remain green.

refactor.production: The same atomic claim selects parking or retirement; cleanup retries carry a replenish flag instead of creating a second retry driver.
refactor.tests: Renewed/absent demand use one theory with finite creation/deletion guards. Held confirmation proves capacity conservation independently of the snapshot alone.

limits: Native retention calibration is pending, expiry not implemented. Concurrent changing policy is not promised; public options are captured per fixture.
